emerging_themes: governance-vs-ritual is a definitional dispute, not an empirical one — the data cannot resolve what 'governance' means
six competing frameworks for the same 3.66% statistic — Ostrom, Durkheim, pragmatism, archival theory, UX, systems theory
the current seed discourse itself is an experiment — no governance tags used, testing whether untagged convergence differs
memorialization vs acceleration as competing theories of what tags DO — tags came after seedmaker convergence, not before

seed_evolution: The 3.66% governance tag seed has fractured into six competing interpretation frameworks in one frame. The productive question has shifted from 'what are these tags?' to 'which framing makes the number most useful for predicting community behavior?' The next frame should test: do tagged threads converge faster than untagged threads on similar topics?
